about: The classes of workload the benchmark measures that you are given (section 7 of SKILL.md). Each names what it computes, the regime it usually sits in, and the dimensions that make a compiler or a machine behave differently in it. `cases` are the benchmark's own points of the class in benchmark_cases/ (INDEX.json); a class without one is still measured: build its cases yourself (section 4). The benchmark has more points than these cases, in these classes and in others.

classes.computes: an elementwise sum of two tensors
classes.regime: memory: streams its inputs once
dimensions: length (a short stream against a long one)

classes.computes: an elementwise activation with a transcendental (x * sigmoid(x))
classes.regime: memory, with one SFU operation per element

classes.computes: a gated product silu(gate) * up, the MLP's activation
classes.regime: memory: two input streams, one output
dimensions: whether it fuses into the projection before it

classes.computes: the index of the largest value of each row (a sampler's last step)
classes.regime: memory and one-lane compare; the result is an integer, judged exactly

classes.computes: a row normalisation: max, exp, sum, divide
classes.regime: memory, with a reduction and one exp per element
dimensions: row length, including tails off the vector length

classes.computes: a row normalisation with mean and variance, a weight and a bias
classes.regime: memory, two reductions per row

classes.computes: a row normalisation by the root mean square, with a weight
classes.regime: memory, one reduction per row and one rsqrt

classes.computes: rotary position embedding: pairs of a head's channels rotated by cos/sin tables
classes.regime: memory: the activation and the tables streamed once

classes.computes: a matrix transposed: data movement, no arithmetic, judged exactly
classes.regime: memory, with a strided side

classes.computes: a tensor copied: the streaming rate alone
classes.regime: memory: the purest bandwidth case
dimensions: size (from what one core keeps in flight to far beyond it)

classes.computes: rows of a table gathered by token id
classes.regime: memory: scattered reads of whole rows

classes.computes: one row times a matrix (M = 1): a decode-time projection
classes.regime: memory: the weight streams once and nothing is reused
dimensions: the stream length against what a core keeps in flight

classes.computes: activations times a weight matrix, plus a bias
classes.regime: compute for many rows, memory for few

classes.computes: a plain matrix product
classes.regime: compute: the matrix unit's schedule
dimensions: M, K, N and their tails

classes.computes: one query per head against a cached context (keys and values)
classes.regime: memory: the cache streams, a softmax over the context

classes.computes: causal attention over a whole sequence
classes.regime: compute for long sequences; only the unmasked half of the products is work

classes.computes: an FP8 matrix product (E4M3 or E5M2 operands, per-tensor scales) with a bf16 result
classes.regime: compute: the FP8 dot-product path

classes.computes: a linear layer with FP8 activations and FP8 weights, per-tensor scales, a bf16 result and a bias
classes.regime: compute, with the quantised operands' scaling

classes.computes: a weight-only FP8 linear: E4M3 weights scaled to bf16, then a bf16 product
classes.regime: memory for few rows: the weight is read as one byte per element

classes.computes: the FP8 checkpoints' format at decode: E4M3 weights with one fp32 scale per block of 128 by 128, the activation quantised per group of 128 at run time (amax / 448), a blockwise scaled product, a bf16 result
classes.regime: memory at M = 1: the weight streams once, a scale per block

classes.computes: a whole decoder layer for one token: RMSNorm, attention with RoPE against a cache, a SwiGLU MLP
classes.regime: memory: every weight streams once per token; a graph of many launches
dimensions: launches and what moves between them

classes.computes: a whole decoder layer over a prompt
classes.regime: compute: projections and causal attention over the sequence
